About Us

Founded in 1983, our company began as a salvage yard specializing in used parts for heavy-duty trucks. By 1992, we expanded into used automotive parts, serving customers with quality recycled components.

As the recycling industry evolved, so did we. In 2019 we began purchasing catalytic converters, followed by electronic scrap (e-scrap) in 2023. In 2024 we expanded again to include non-ferrous metals such as copper, aluminum, and brass.

At the end of 2025, we closed our used auto parts division to focus entirely on our recycling operations. Today we are transitioning into a full-service scrap yard providing fair prices and responsible recycling for metals, catalytic converters, and e-scrap.
